nom: Peace Out Salicylic Acid Acne Healing Dots

segments.oily: The one review covering multiple family members with oily to combination skin says the patches stayed on and worked even on the oiliest skin in the family.
segments.combination: The same review covering oily to combination skin says the patches worked well and stayed adhered even on the oiliest skin.
segments.sensitive: The two reviewers who describe sensitive skin, including one wary of retinol specifically, report no irritation and no breakdown of their skin from the patches.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and in perimenopause, dealing with hormonal or adult acne, report the patches work as well as or better than other brands they have tried, with the added benefit of blending in rather than announcing themselves.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority report a visibly flatter, less swollen blemish by morning or within a few hours, several noting fewer post-acne marks and less picking; a few reviewers say it works mainly on surface-level pimples and only partly helps or does not fully resolve deep cystic acne, and two report it did nothing or caused a burn instead of healing.
concerns.redness: Nearly all reviewers who mention redness say it visibly calms down overnight; the exception is a reviewer who developed a chemical burn from the patch, leaving a new round red mark where it had been.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers credit consistent use with fewer post-acne dark marks or scars forming; no reviewer reports new spots or discoloration from using the patches.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically notes the patches do not disrupt her skin barrier; no other reviewer comments on barrier effects directly.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers who address the question say the patches calm and dry out the blemish itself without drying out the surrounding skin; no reviewer reports the patches leaving their skin dehydrated.

aspects.libelle: Adheres well overnight, doesn't lift off
Won't stick well over moisturized or damp skin
Thin and discreet enough to wear all day
Larger and more visible than other brands for one reviewer
Satisfying to watch it draw out impurities
Creates a barrier that curbs picking at skin

extraits.texte: These patches did nothing to heal my acne. They caused a chemical burn so now I'm stuck with a round red burn where the patch was. I wish I didn't use this product because my spot would have healed already without it.
I used this twice on a white head and they didn't do a thing for it. Quite disappointed in it.

gifted by peaceoutskincare. Good acne dots, but I wouldn't say they're any better than any of the others I've used. I like the packaging they came in, which keeps each little pack fresh and seperate. Good sizes included. I tried them on cystic acne and normal acne, did great with the normal acne- definitely helped the cystic a bit. Worked well, but they didn't stand out anymore than others I've tried as I said before.

extraits.titre: Best Acne Dots on the market❣️
extraits.texte: I am a 40 somethin year old woman with hormone changes causing me to have adult acne. These acne dots are the best out there❣️ I've tried at least 4 other brands & these work best hands down. From actually diminishing the appearance of the acne to staying in place overnight. they are awesome 😍

gifted by peaceoutskincare complimentary of peaceoutskincare I always see people walking around with different shapes of pimple patches but I am an old lady and having a star on my face is not the look I am going for. I am perimenopausal age(or cougar puberty, as it is playfully referred to) and the hormonal shifts(which there are many of) is causing mild acne. I put one of these on a pimple that hadn't surfaced yet but was there. It blended in with my skin tone so no bold, in your face pimple patch(which I love) It also worked overnight and the pimple surfaced and was gone. Not only did it not bother my skin but I ended up forgetting it was on me! These are perfect for those that would like to be more discreet with their pimple patches!

I absolutely loved these acne patches they stay on and put where ever they are placed which is amazing because I have tried a couple and they fall off within minutes so it's great to have a patch I can sleep in and not worry about it my daughters both used these as well and we all have oily to combo skin and the fact that it worked on even the most oily skin and stayed on it's amazing gifted by peaceoutakincare

I love these pimple patches gifted by peaceoutskincare. I have very sensitive skin so I am always weary to try new things. I have had no issues with these patches. They stick all day or night long and they do not break my skin. They are definitely effective at drying acne up and I will continue to use them!!
